as_told.title: Planned meeting with Lee Hively in Colorado Springs falls through

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says he tried to reach Lee Hively, a man working in an advanced branch of electrical physics, based in Colorado Springs. In one telling Michels says a friend helped connect them, but Hively got scared, said they should not be contacting him, and added Navy press staff to the message thread. In another telling Michels says they were about to meet in person when Hively seemed to get nervous and the door was shut in his face. Michels tells it as a sign that this kind of research is touchy for those inside it.
